$comment: Daily changes on top of upstream react-native-webrtc. Patches are generated with `git format-patch` from the daily/<baseTag> branch (one commit per patch) and applied in order with `git am -3`.

regenerate.reason: Lockfile diffs conflict on every upgrade; regenerate after applying patches.

repoOnly.$comment: Fork tooling that lives only in this repo, is never part of a patch, and is ignored when comparing patched upstream with main.

coverage.$comment: patches.sh coverage: every native method, JS method and native event the patches add or change must be named in selfTest, except the internal ones listed here with the reason.

internal._registerEvents: MediaDevices constructor helper; covered by the devicechange check.

patches.title: Publish as @daily-co/react-native-webrtc
patches.reason: Package identity of the Daily fork: npm name/version/repo, nativePackage flag, tag/prepublishOnly scripts, CocoaPods name kept as react-native-webrtc, Daily-only README, ignore files.
patches.verify: npm pack produces daily-co-react-native-webrtc-<version>.tgz; pod install resolves the 'react-native-webrtc' pod.
patches.notes: Bump package.json version (<upstream>-daily.N) on every release.

patches.title: Update TypeScript, builder-bob and React typings
patches.reason: Build with typescript 5.8, react-native-builder-bob 0.39 and @types/react 19; tsconfig 'types' restricted to avoid @types/node conflicts; RTCPIPView fallbackView typed as React.ReactNode (required by @types/react 19).
patches.obsoleteWhen: Upstream devDependencies are at or above these versions and RTCPIPView uses React.ReactNode. Drop or trim the version lines that upstream already matches.
patches.verify: npm run lint (eslint + tsc --noEmit) and npm run prepare succeed.

patches.title: Ship root index.d.ts with Daily types
patches.reason: react-native-daily-js relies on RTCViewProps, MediaTrackConstraints (mandatory/optional), MediaDeviceInfo and MediaDeviceKind; package.json 'types' points to ./index.d.ts.
patches.verify: Re-exports in index.d.ts match the exports of upstream src/index.ts (add any new upstream export); react-native-daily-js type-checks against the package.

patches.title: Native switchCamera and camera facing mode getter
patches.reason: MediaStreamTrack._switchCamera() calls native mediaStreamTrackSwitchCamera and resolves the new facing mode; adds _getCameraFacingMode(). Android remembers the chosen facing mode while the camera is stopped (video muted) and handles devices with more than two cameras (Samsung).
patches.obsoleteWhen: Upstream switchCamera returns the resulting facing mode, works while the track is muted, and handles more than two cameras.
patches.verify: Switch camera with video on and with video muted (then unmute); on a Samsung device with 3+ cameras; facing mode reported correctly on both platforms.
patches.notes: _switchCamera must keep _settings.facingMode current: upstream applyConstraints falls back to it when no facingMode is given, which would otherwise flip the camera back. Replaces upstream's constraints-based _switchCamera. Upstream changes to CameraCaptureController / VideoCaptureController are the usual conflict source.

patches.title: Audio output routing and devicechange events
patches.reason: Daily devices manager replaces upstream enumerateDevices (also lists audio outputs: earpiece/wired, speaker, bluetooth) and adds setAudioDevice, getAudioDevice, startMediaDevicesEventMonitor and the mediaDevicesOnDeviceChange event wired to mediaDevices 'devicechange' / navigator.mediaDevices.ondevicechange. Includes the iOS DailyAudioMode state category that the devices manager depends on.
patches.verify: enumerateDevices lists cameras, mics and audio outputs; switching speaker/earpiece/bluetooth works; plugging/unplugging a headset fires devicechange.
patches.notes: Highest conflict risk: upstream enumerateDevices is bypassed (Android) / commented out (iOS). Review upstream changes to enumerateDevices and port them into the Daily devices manager (the iOS uniqueID nil guard was ported in 155.0.1). MediaDevices._registerEvents still has debug console.log calls.

patches.title: setDailyAudioMode and iOS background keep-alive
patches.reason: setDailyAudioMode(video|voice|idle) manages audio focus and default route (Android DailyAudioManager) or the AVAudioSession category/mode, re-applied when the session reactivates (iOS). setAudioDevice switches to the user-specified route. iOS also exports enableNoOpRecordingEnsuringBackgroundContinuity to keep the app alive in the background.
patches.verify: Video call defaults to speaker, voice call to earpiece; mode survives Wi-Fi to LTE switch on iOS; app stays alive in background after joining with cam+mic off (iOS).

patches.title: Enable MediaProjectionService by default
patches.reason: Enables the media projection foreground service by default, so apps do not have to set the option themselves. Upstream defaults it to false.
patches.obsoleteWhen: Upstream enables the service by default, or Daily enables it from the app side.
patches.verify: Start screen share right after joining on Android 14+; repeat start/stop several times.

patches.title: Silence missing-track warning
patches.reason: iOS no longer emits a yellow-box warning when a stream has no video track yet.
patches.obsoleteWhen: Upstream no longer warns on streams without video.

patches.title: Add examples/DailySelfTest
patches.reason: Minimal Expo app that checks the Daily-specific features on a device or emulator (the other patches' APIs), and scripts/run-selftest.sh, which fails unless every check passes. Run it with the daily-selftest skill.
patches.verify: cd examples/DailySelfTest && npm run install-local && npx expo prebuild --no-install && npm run android && npm test -- android: SELFTEST DONE failed=0.
patches.notes: Its expo/react/react-native versions may need a bump when upstream requires a newer React Native. Add a check to src/selfTest.ts whenever a patch adds a Daily-facing API.
